claim: Batch Size = 1 时的理论峰值吞吐量 (Tokens/s) 公式为 Throughput = Memory_Bandwidth_GBps / Weight_Size_GB，Qwen3-27B BF16 下：RTX 4090 ≈ 18.7 Tokens/s，A100 80GB ≈ 37.8 Tokens/s。
